content: iOS Safari does not reliably support the HTML anchor download attribute or canvas.toDataURL/toBlob -> auto-download flow; WebKit bug 167341 tracks lack of full download attribute support. Programmatic clicks on blob-URL anchors are silently ignored unless fired synchronously inside a real touch/click event handler (not after an async fetch/canvas render completes on a timer). Confirmed still true as of iOS 17.x (2024-2025 WebKit forum threads, blob URLs even broke entirely in 17.4.1). Recommended pattern: render the composited image, then on direct user tap either (a) call navigator.share({files:[...]}) where supported so the OS share sheet offers 'Save Image', with a fallback for (b) opening the image in a new tab / img element so the user long-presses and taps 'Add to Photos' -- do not rely on triggering an automatic file download.
